title: API UnitAttackPower
wikitext: base, posBuff, negBuff = UnitAttackPower("unit"); Returns the unit's melee attack power and modifiers. ---- ; ''Arguments'' : ("unit") :; unit :: String - The [[API Type UnitId|UnitId]] to get information from. (Does not work for "target" - Possibly only "player" and "pet") ---- ; ''Returns'' : base, posBuff, negBuff :; base :: Number - The unit's base attack power :; posBuff :: Number - The total effect of positive buffs to attack power. :; negBuff :: Number - The total effect of negative buffs to the attack power (a negative number) ---- ; ''Example'' local base, posBuff, negBuff = UnitAttackPower("unit"); local effective = base + posBuff + negBuff; ---- == Macros == Shows you target attack power after reduction. change 126 depending on roar rank. /cast Demoralizing Roar /run a=UnitAttackPower("target") - 126 if a ~= lastAttackPower then DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(a) lastAttackPower = a end [[Category:API Functions]]
